stage0050a_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「We've arrived at the target, Point X」

stage0050a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Does that island hold the key to humanity's end?」

stage0050a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「No anomalies detected in the surrounding area」

stage0050a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We have no choice but to proceed」

stage0050a_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「As expected, there seems to be nothing here...」

stage0050a_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Guess that man, $$アドヴェント$$,
　played us for fools, huh」

stage0050a_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we can't let our guard down.
　Good chance this is some kind of trap」

stage0050a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$フェルト$$
「The dimensional boundary's warping rapidly!」

stage0050a_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「A $$時空震動$$, at a time like this!?」

stage0050a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Is this the end of humanity, then!?」

stage0050a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Same as when our world transferred over!」
